decisions.title: Adopt TypeScript/Node/Vitest/ESLint/npm workspaces as the canonical Factory stack
decisions.context: Phase 0 required a concrete, boring, well-supported toolchain for the clean-slate repository foundation.
decisions.decision: Use TypeScript on Node.js with npm workspaces, Vitest for tests and ESLint for linting, per TECH-STACK.md.
decisions.consequences: All canonical packages under packages/* follow this stack unless a future ADR supersedes it.

decisions.title: Represent requirement/invariant/policy registries as canonical JSON files under specification/
decisions.context: Phase 1 requires machine-readable, Git-tracked registries that a new AI session can resume from without rereading chat history, per ARCHITECTURE-CONSTITUTION.md#3 and #5.
decisions.decision: Store the requirement registry, invariant registry, policy registry, ADR log, traceability matrix, baseline version and Implementation Reality Matrix as JSON files under specification/, validated by a deterministic Node script (specification/validate-registries.mjs) rather than embedding this data only in TypeScript source or documentation prose.
decisions.consequences: Registries are diffable, greppable and validated independently of any single AI agent's assertions; later governance/runtime phases (Phase 2+) can read the same files instead of re-deriving them.
